```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}

def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl
```

## 3.1 Entry point into BAHSA: pathway type and level

DV: `rt_entries[["pathway_type", "pathway_level"]]`

```{python}
#| output: asis
rt_entries = dpw_rt_starts.copy()
print(f"Routes: {len(rt_entries):,}")
rt_entries["pathway"] = rt_entries["svc_type_short"]
rt_entries["pathway_type"] = (rt_entries["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
# Create univariate table for new DV, rt_entries[["pathway_type", "pathway_level"]]
n = rt_entries[["pathway_type", "pathway_level"]].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n").astype("Int64")
pct = (100 * rt_entries[["pathway_type", "pathway_level"]].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1).sort_index()
tbl.loc[("All", "All"),:] = tbl.sum()
excel_output["Table 3.1: Entry point into BAHSA services"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
```

## 3.2 Outcomes at a period of time after a route started

Period: 3.08 years

DV: `dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"]`

```{python}
#| output: asis
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
years = periodMult["y"]
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
print(f"Routes: {len(dpw_rt_ends):,}")
print("")
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id", drop=False)
end_cols_to_drop = dpw_rt_ends.columns[
    (
        dpw_rt_ends.columns.isin(["gap", "dur"])
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("prev_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("vac_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("pl_")
    )]
dpw_routes = dpw_rt_ends.drop(columns=end_cols_to_drop)
dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] = dpw_rt_starts.set_index("route_id")["pl_start_dt"].rename("rt_start_dt")
dpw_routes["rt_end_dt"] = dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"].rename("rt_end_dt")
# Set up map from categories to outcomes
rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}
rts_excluded = {
    f"Routes started within 3.08 yrs of end ({distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt.strftime("%d/%m/%Y")})":
        (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure).sum(),
    "Routes with outcome: " + ", ".join(cat for cat in dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].unique() if cat not in rt_end_cat_map):
        ((dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
         & ~(dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))).sum()
}
excluded_df = pd.DataFrame(data=rts_excluded.values(), columns=["n"], index=rts_excluded.keys())
excluded_df.index = excluded_df.index.rename("Excluded routes")
display(excluded_df)
dpw_rt_outcomes = dpw_routes[
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to an outcome
    & (dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))]
dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"] = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].map(rt_end_cat_map)
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure)),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure).rename("rt_timemeasure_dt")
rt_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt, on="route_id", how="inner")
rt_pls_at_timemeasures = rt_pls[(rt_pls["pl_start_dt"] < rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                & (
                                    rt_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                    | (rt_pls["pl_end_dt"] > rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                )].set_index("route_id")
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"]))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No"),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
# Create univariate table for new DV, dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"]
n = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n").astype("Int64")
pct = (100 * dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
tbl.index = tbl.index.rename("Route outcome")
tbl.loc["All", :] = tbl.sum()
excel_output["Table 3.2: Route outcomes after 3.08 years"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
print("""
::: {.callout-note}
- "Insecure outcome" includes still being in Level 1 or 2 of the homelessness or substance use pathways,
  or level 3/4 in shared accommodation.
- "Independent outcome" includes being in Level 1 or 2 of the homelessness or substance use pathways
:::
""")
```

## 3.3 Outcomes at a period of time after a person's first route started

Period: 3.08 years

DV: `dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_outcome"]`

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"Potentially relevant route outcomes (from 3.2): {len(dpw_rt_outcomes):,}")
print("")
# dpw_cli_outcomes is the dpw_rt_outcome that is active after the measured time since the person's first route started
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
# Relevant date for each client is their first route start date plus the time measure period
dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes
                          .set_index("o_cli_id")
                          .groupby("o_cli_id")
                          .head(1)
                          ["rt_start_dt"]
                          + time_measure).rename("cli_timemeasure_dt")
dpw_cli_outcomes = dpw_rt_outcomes.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id").set_index("o_cli_id")
rts_excluded = {
    "Additional routes for the same person":
        (dpw_rt_outcomes.groupby("o_cli_id").size() - 1).sum(),
}
excluded_df = pd.DataFrame(data=rts_excluded.values(), columns=["n"], index=rts_excluded.keys())
excluded_df.index = excluded_df.index.rename("Excluded routes")
display(excluded_df)
# Select the latest route that started before the outcome date
dpw_cli_outcomes = ((dpw_cli_outcomes[dpw_cli_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] <= dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_timemeasure_dt"]])
                    .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)).rename(columns={"rt_outcome": "cli_outcome"})
cli_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id")
cli_pls_at_timemeasures = cli_pls[(cli_pls["pl_start_dt"] < cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  & (
                                      cli_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                      | (cli_pls["pl_end_dt"] > cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  )].set_index("o_cli_id")
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[cli_pls_at_timemeasures.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
equiv_ind_at_time = cli_pls_at_timemeasures[
    (cli_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No")
    & cli_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"])]
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[equiv_ind_at_time.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_start_dt"] = (dpw_rt_starts.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                    .groupby("o_cli_id").head(1)["pl_start_dt"])
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_end_dt"] = (dpw_rt_ends.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)["pl_end_dt"])
# Create univariate table for new DV, dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_outcome"]
n = dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_outcome"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n").astype("Int64")
pct = (100 * dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_outcome"].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
tbl.loc["All", :] = tbl.sum()
tbl.index = tbl.index.rename("Route outcome")
excel_output[f"Table 3.3: Route outcomes after 3.08 years"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
print("""
::: {.callout-note}
- "Insecure outcome" includes still being in Level 1 or 2 of the homelessness or substance use pathways,
  or level 3/4 in shared accommodation.
- "Independent outcome" includes being in Level 1 or 2 of the homelessness or substance use pathways
:::
""")
```

## 3.4 Returning to use services multiple times

3+ routes during the period, i.e. 2 or more returns in 7.5 years.

DV: `dpw_clis["multiple_returns"]`

```{python}
#| output: asis
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
print(f"People: {len(dpw_clis):,}")
print("")
dpw_clis["multiple_returns"] = (dpw_rt_starts.groupby(['o_cli_id']).size() >= 3).rename("multiple_returns")
# Create univariate table for new DV, dpw_clis["multiple_returns"]
n = dpw_clis["multiple_returns"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n").astype("Int64")
pct = (100 * dpw_clis["multiple_returns"].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
tbl.loc["All", :] = tbl.sum()
tbl.index = tbl.index.rename("Multiple returns")
excel_output[f"Table 3.4: People with multiple returns during 7.5 yrs"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
```

## 3.5 Using services longer-term

Has had a route in the top 10% of route durations.

DV: `dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"]`

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"People: {len(dpw_clis):,}")
print("")
durations = dpw_pls.set_index(["o_cli_id", "route_id"])[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"]).groupby(["o_cli_id", "route_id"]).sum()
# Set threshold to top 10% of route durations
longer_term_threshold_days = durations.quantile(0.9)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"] = ((durations > longer_term_threshold_days)
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").any())
# Create univariate table for new DV, dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"]
n = dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n").astype("Int64")
pct = (100 * dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
tbl.loc["All", :] = tbl.sum()
tbl.index = tbl.index.rename("Had a longer-term route")
excel_output[f"Table 3.5: People with a route in top 10% of route durations"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
```

## 3.6 Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation

```{python}
#| output: asis
# time_measure options: ['90d', '6m', '15m', '18m', '2y', '5y']
time_measure = "2y"
time_offset = distinct_pathways.stable_offsets[time_measure]
return_col = f"after_rt_ret_within_{time_measure}"
eligible_route_ends = dpw_rt_ends[
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to independent accommodation
    dpw_rt_ends["rt_end_cat"].isin(["To social housing", "To private rented"])
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    & (dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"] < distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_offset)]
# Create univariate table for new DV, dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"]
print(f"DV: `eligible_route_ends[\"{return_col}\"]`")
print("")
n = eligible_route_ends[return_col].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("n")
pct = (100 * eligible_route_ends[return_col].value_counts(dropna=False, normalize=True)).rename("pct")
tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
tbl.index = tbl.index.rename("Returned within 2y")
excel_output[f"Table 3.6: Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation"] = tbl
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 1):
    display(tbl)
```

Note: Not enough returns after moves to independent accommodation to analyse much further.

## 3.7 Outcomes from individual placements

DV: `pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc["pl_outcome"]`

```{python}
#| output: asis
import numpy as np
from python_scripts import routes
pl_excluded = {}
pl_end_cat_map = routes.get_end_cats_map()
pl_outcomes = dpw_pls.set_index("vac_id")
pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_reason"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
next_pls = (dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_vac_id"].notna()]
            .rename(columns={"vac_id": "next_vac_id", "prev_vac_id": "vac_id", "svc_type_short": "pathway"})
            .set_index("vac_id"))
next_pls["pathway"] = next_pls["pathway"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes.loc[next_pls.index, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move"
pl_outcomes.loc[dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_svc_id"] == dpw_pls["svc_id"], "prev_vac_id"].values, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move: same service"
pl_outcomes["pathway"] = pl_outcomes["svc_type_short"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes["pathway_type"] = (pl_outcomes["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
pl_outcomes["ended"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "Current", False: "Ended"})
tbl = get_frequencies(pl_outcomes[["ended"]], sort=False, dropna=False)
tbl.loc[tuple(["All"] * len(tbl.index.levels)), :] = tbl.sum()
tbl = tbl.convert_dtypes()
tbl_desc = "Table 3.7.1: All placements"
excel_output[tbl_desc] = tbl
print("### " + tbl_desc)
display(tbl)
print("")
level_diff = (pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move", ["pathway", "pathway_level"]]
              .join(next_pls[["pathway", "pathway_level"]].add_prefix("next_"))
              .assign(level_diff=lambda df: df[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]]
              .astype("Int64").diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]))
# Difference in level is meaningful except that moves to/from SU pathway are different..
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes.join((level_diff[["next_pathway_level", "level_diff"]]
                                .where((level_diff["pathway"] == level_diff["next_pathway"])
                                       | (level_diff["pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway")
                                       | (level_diff["next_pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway"))))
pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["level_diff"].notna(), "pl_end_cat"] = (
    "Internal move: " + np.sign(pl_outcomes.level_diff).map({-1: "backwards", 0: "sideways", 1: "forwards"})
)
# Exclude 738 placements that have not ended
pl_excluded["Not-ended placements"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].isna()]
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].notna()]
# Exclude 42 0-day placements
pl_excluded["Zero-day placements"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] == pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] > pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome (external)': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
pl_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in pl_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in pl_outcomes_map[outcome]}
pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
pl_outcomes.loc[
    pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].fillna("").str.startswith("Internal move"),
    "pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"]
# Exclude 1,310 moves within the same service
pl_excluded["Moves within same service"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move: same service"]
pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] != "Internal move: same service"]
# Exclude 277 moves due to end reasons: 53 missing reaons, 200 "Other"
# TODO: Should "Other" really be excluded?
### In [310]: pl_outcomes.set_index("pl_outcome").loc["Other"].pl_end_reason.astype("string").value_counts()
### Out[310]: 
### pl_end_reason
### Other (Planned)                                           141
### Other (Unplanned)                                          58
### (SSTS) BCC Emergency Accommodation (FOR SSTS USE ONLY)      1
### Name: count, dtype: Int64
pl_excluded["Unclear end categories"] = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"].isna()]
tbl_desc = "Table 3.7.2: Placements excluded from placement outcome DV construction"
tbl = pd.DataFrame([len(pls) for pls in pl_excluded.values()], index=pl_excluded.keys(), columns=["n"])
tbl.loc["All"] = tbl.sum()
print("### " + tbl_desc)
display(tbl)
print("")
# Output univariate table for DV: pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc["pl_outcome"]
tbl = get_frequencies(pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc["pl_outcome"], dropna=True)
tbl.loc["All", :] = tbl.sum()
tbl = tbl.convert_dtypes()
tbl_desc = "Table 3.7.3: Placement outcomes"
excel_output[tbl_desc] = tbl
print("### " + tbl_desc)
display(tbl)
print("")
```

## Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row, float_format="%.1f")
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
